context_for_next_testing_agent: Merchant barcode scan payment flow fully tested and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/payment/merchant-scan (merchant initiates payment by scanning customer barcode), GET /api/payment/my-barcode (customer gets their barcode). Fee is 2.5% (FEES['payment']). Barcode format: BLZ-[A-F0-9]{12}. Idempotency via idempotency_key field. Compliance single_max=2500 for payments. Atomic balance check uses MongoDB $gte. ScannerPage accessible via nav-scan-btn in bottom nav. BarcodeModal accessible via quick-action-barcode in WalletPage.
